name: Feature request / new adapter
about: Suggest a new ATS adapter, lead source, or capability
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
body:
---

**What would you like JobPilot to do?**
A clear description of the feature, adapter, or lead source.

**Which part?**
- [ ] New ATS adapter (`src/mcp/forms.js`)
- [ ] New lead source (`src/mcp/sources.js`)
- [ ] Easy Apply / Connect behaviour
- [ ] Evolution / answer memory
- [ ] Dashboard / onboarding
- [ ] Other

**Why it helps**
What jobs or workflows does this unlock?

**Notes / links**
Example URLs, ATS docs, or an API endpoint if relevant.
